project.title: OULAD Critical Dataset Analysis
project.description: A living critical notebook on the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD).
project.introText: A living critical notebook for HCI Theory and Data that follows one dataset for eight weeks: the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD).
project.middleText: Each week adds a short entry and nothing is deleted: superseded decisions stay visible, with a change log and a log of AI use. It begins with a positionality note and asks what the dataset's categories capture and leave out about the students in it.

summary.brief: Learning-analytics data sorts students into categories: what do they capture, and what do they leave out?
summary.method: A living notebook: weekly entries, superseded decisions kept visible, a change log and a log of AI use.

facts: logs kept: changes and AI use
project.shows: Critical, transparent work with data, with every decision kept on record.
